description: Update the notification email address for an existing WBS number, without changing the WBS number itself (FR-006).

wbsNumber.description: The existing WBS number to update, URL-encoded (may contain '.' characters)

notification_email.description: New syntactically valid email address; trimmed before validation (FR-005)

notification_email: Must be a syntactically valid email address

forbidden_403.body: you are not authorized to access this resource

body.message: WBS number not found in registry: {wbsNumber}

side_effects: Updates notification_email, updated_by, updated_by_name, updated_at on the matching WbsNotification document
On validation failure, the previously saved email is left unchanged (spec.md User Story 3 Acceptance Scenario 2)
notes: wbs_number itself cannot be changed via this endpoint — per spec.md Assumptions, an in-place rename is out of scope; remove + add covers that case
